questions.question: A developer needs to update a logged-in user's email address using the Android Kotlin SDK. Which method correctly sets this standard attribute?
questions.explanation: The correct Android SDK method is Braze.getInstance().setEmail() which properly sets the user's email address.

questions.question: True or False: You can customize notification sounds for push messages in Braze.
questions.explanation: Push notification sounds can be customized in Braze to provide unique audio feedback for different message types.
